name: Duck Typing Without Contracts
essence: A value is used as if it has a shape no one ever guaranteed it has.

examples.summary: An invoice's dollar amount is charged as if it were cents.
examples.mechanism: Charger only requires Amount() int, so dollars and cents both satisfy it (CWE-843).

examples.summary: The default arm asserts a struct into map[string]any and panics.
examples.mechanism: The type switch names one shape and treats every other value as a map (CWE-843).
examples.observed_output: panic: interface conversion: interface {} is main.Row, not map[string]interface {}

examples.summary: An invoice's dollar amount is charged as if it were cents.
examples.mechanism: The trait method is an i32 with no unit, so both impls type-check (CWE-843).

examples.summary: The trait's default must() unwraps a missing sku.
examples.mechanism: The default method promises a value find() never guaranteed (CWE-476).

examples.summary: An invoice's dollar amount is charged as if it were cents.
examples.mechanism: Charger is structural, so a dollars method and a cents method are the same type (CWE-843).

examples.summary: A string is passed where a list with map is required, and the call throws.
examples.mechanism: The cast erases the missing method; at runtime the string has no map (CWE-843).
examples.observed_output: TypeError: items.map is not a function

examples.summary: persist calls save on a document that has no save.
examples.mechanism: The method is optional in the type and still invoked (CWE-476).
examples.observed_output: TypeError: doc.save is not a function

examples.summary: An order id and a user id are swapped at the call.
examples.mechanism: Both parameters are string, so the arguments type-check in either order (CWE-843).
examples.observed_output: ship order u-9 to user o-4
examples.expected_behavior: ship order o-4 to user u-9

examples.summary: A kelvin reading is converted with the celsius formula.
examples.mechanism: Reading only requires value, so the unit field is invisible to the function (CWE-843).
Both classes offer amount() with no unit. The caller adds the numbers as if they were the same scale.

examples.summary: The title ADA is iterated into the characters A, D, and A.
examples.mechanism: A str is iterable. The comprehension never checks that each row is a title.

examples.summary: Draft has no save method, so store raises AttributeError.
examples.mechanism: The call assumes the method exists. Nothing checked the shape before the call.
examples.expected_behavior: the draft is stored or refused before the call

examples.summary: The link is o-9->u-1 because the two string ids were passed in the other order.
examples.mechanism: Both ids are str. Nothing in the call distinguishes a user id from an order id.

examples.summary: A 300 kelvin reading is converted with the Celsius formula and prints 572.0.
examples.mechanism: The function only requires .value. Kelvin and Celsius share that attribute and not the unit.
